sources.title: Guidelines for Embedding Metadata in Broadcast WAVE Files
sources.publisher: Federal Agencies Digital Guidelines Initiative Audio-Visual Working Group
sources.version_or_commit: Version 3; approved 2021-04-26; current status verified on FADGI guide page
sources.locator: PDF pp. 2-3 (scope and revisions), pp. 6-10 (Originator, OriginatorReference, Description and dates), pp. 12-15 (CodingHistory), pp. 22-25 (cue, adtl, ltxt, Purpose=tran and ASCII text)
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official PDF and inspected its table of contents, field definitions, constraints, applicability labels, revision notes, and transcript-purpose section; no sample file or application was run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The guideline applies to metadata embedded in Broadcast WAVE; specific fields are strongly recommended, recommended, or optional. BEXT identifier fields have ASCII and fixed-length constraints. ltxt Purpose is recommended when implementing ltxt; tran is a permitted purpose, while its free text is ASCII and RIFF requires null termination/padding. FADGI notes BEXT origination date/time represents local archival-entity time, not unambiguous UTC.
sources.applicability: Technical guidance for optional BWF embedding in this pilot; not a requirement for volunteer recorder applications or all WAV files. Local field authority remains an owner decision.

sources.title: Guidelines: Embedding Metadata in Broadcast WAVE Files
sources.version_or_commit: Live guide; identifies Version 3 as current, approved 2021-04-26; page last updated 2025-02-26
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official FADGI guide and read current version, date, linked PDF, field scope, MetaEdit support and checksum caveat.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The guide says embedded metadata can work in synergy with organizational databases; current BWF guidance references bext, INFO, cue and adtl. MetaEdit v21.07+ supports cue/adtl additions. The advertised MetaEdit MD5 is for the WAVE data/audio bitstream and is an ad hoc chunk.
sources.applicability: Supports optional BWF workflow and preserves distinction between embedded convenience metadata and organizational authority; not a recorder-compatibility guarantee.

sources.title: EBU Tech 3285 v2: Broadcast Wave Format Specification
sources.locator: PDF pp. 7-10 (version compatibility and BEXT fields), pp. 6, 14-19 (RIFF/WAVE chunks and optional/unknown chunks)
sources.observed_operation: Opened the EBU-hosted PDF and inspected version compatibility, BEXT field layout, and RIFF unknown/optional chunk handling.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: BWF is based on RIFF/WAVE plus a BEXT chunk. Optional chunks are not supported by all applications; unknown chunks are expected to be ignored. BWF v2 is backward-compatible in the limited sense that older readers may ignore UMID or loudness metadata.
sources.applicability: Primary format evidence for optional BWF embedding and compatibility tradeoffs; it does not establish behavior of any untested volunteer recorder or editor.

sources.title: BWF MetaEdit project page
sources.version_or_commit: Live project page listed version 26.08.1 at access; page does not pin the help text to a code commit
sources.locator: Lines 37-40 (purpose/platform provenance), 59-69 (current version and supported operations), 83-88 (help/workflow links)
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official project page and read its listed version, platform availability, metadata operations, export formats, validation and checksum scope.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Tool supports specified BWF metadata import/edit/embed/export and CSV/XML extraction; MD5 evaluates/verifies/embeds a digest of the audio data chunk only, not a full-file hash.
sources.applicability: A plausible post-ingest working-copy tool, not a requirement and not a substitute for an independent full-file fixity manifest.

sources.title: BWF MetaEdit help: BEXT Audio Metadata Information
sources.version_or_commit: Unversioned rolling help page; project page listed BWF MetaEdit 26.08.1 at access; documentation commit unavailable
sources.locator: Description, Originator, OriginatorReference and OriginationDate/Time entries; especially Description and OriginatorReference constraints and security note
sources.observed_operation: Opened the help page and inspected field definitions and FADGI application notes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: EBU BEXT fields use bounded ASCII structures; FADGI suggests short principal identifiers and pointers to external metadata, while warning against sensitive pathnames. FADGI guidance may differ from underlying EBU requirements/recommendations.
sources.applicability: Useful optional field mapping only after the archivist selects field authority; do not force long or Unicode-rich prose into these fields.

sources.title: BWF MetaEdit help: LIST-INFO Audio Metadata Information
sources.version_or_commit: Unversioned rolling help page; documentation commit unavailable
sources.locator: IARL, ICMT, ICOP and INAM entries; FADGI warning that embedded values can be stale; optional labels and relation to BEXT
sources.observed_operation: Opened the help page and read the INFO field descriptions and notes about changing descriptive metadata.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Many LIST-INFO fields are optional; if present, specific guidance may call for consistency with BEXT. The docs say embedded values may not be the latest/best and direct readers to identifiers for newer information.
sources.applicability: Supports keeping a linked external authoritative record for later descriptive corrections; it does not select the society's authority policy.

sources.title: BWF MetaEdit help: CORE Document
sources.version_or_commit: Unversioned rolling help page; documentation commit unavailable
sources.locator: Lines 36-56 and CSV/XML format sections (exchange purpose, filepath association, one row per audio file, ASCII constraints)
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official help page and inspected CORE document import/export behavior, file association, and CSV field constraints.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: CORE is BEXT/LIST-INFO exchange; records associate file paths with values and may be imported for embedding. Fields such as Description/Originator/OriginatorReference are constrained ASCII lengths.
sources.applicability: A plausible batch workflow on a copy, but paths are not a stable cross-package identity; the local proposal uses IDs/checksums as authority and tests CSV/XML round trips.

sources.title: BWF MetaEdit help: XML Chunks
sources.version_or_commit: Unversioned rolling help page; documentation commit unavailable
sources.locator: Warning section on aXML, iXML and XMP editing
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official help page and inspected its explicit XML validation and undo warning.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The current help says it does not verify that entered aXML/iXML/XMP content is valid XML or valid instances and offers no undo for such edits.
sources.applicability: A direct caution against assuming all embedded chunk editors validate schemas or provide reversible edits; XML chunks are outside a minimal pilot unless separately validated.

sources.title: BWF MetaEdit GUI release history
sources.version_or_commit: Mutable master view; commit hash was not exposed in the retrieved content. Historical entries identify Version 25.04 (2025-04-30), 23.04 (2023-04-10), 21.07 (2021-07-09), 20.08 (2020-08-11), 0.2.2 (2009-12-22), and earlier fixes.
sources.locator: Lines 11-15: Version 25.04 ISO8859-1 core-file fallback; lines 42-47: Version 23.04 field code-page and CSET support; lines 54-90: Version 21.07 XML UNICODE=1 import fixes; lines 91-103: Version 20.08 XMP/aXML/iXML valid-XML support; lines 268-277: Version 0.2.2 XML CR/special-character fixes and complete-file-write issue; lines 287-300: Version 0.2.0 conditional no-complete-rewrite capability.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official raw release-history text and read the versioned entries. A follow-up attempt to open version-tag URLs timed out, so no immutable commit pin is claimed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Entries are release-history claims for named tool versions, not proof that every other version or application has the same behavior. Encoding support and fallback are scoped to described codepaths/fields; the page is on a moving branch.
sources.applicability: Released history demonstrates actual XML/encoding edge cases and version-specific repairs relevant to metadata exchange; local versions and sample inputs require independent tests.

sources.title: RFC 8493: The BagIt File Packaging Format (V1.0)
sources.publisher: RFC Editor / IETF Datatracker; independent submission
sources.version_or_commit: RFC 8493, BagIt v1.0, October 2018; informational RFC, not IETF Standards Track
sources.locator: Sections 2.1.1-2.1.3 (UTF-8 tag default, opaque payload, mandatory checksum manifests), 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 (optional tag manifest/bag-info), 5.4 (security boundary), 6.1 (filename interoperability)
sources.observed_operation: Opened RFC HTML and inspected required/optional elements, checksum rules, encoding defaults and security limitations.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Every bag requires at least one payload manifest listing each payload file once. UTF-8 is recommended for remaining tag files. Tag manifest and bag-info are optional. Checksums detect corruption but are not designed to secure against active attacks.
sources.applicability: Lightweight, portable package/fixity option for audio plus sidecars/derivatives; it does not validate WAV semantics, provenance authority, consent or accessibility.

sources.title: PREMIS Data Dictionary for Preservation Metadata, Version 3.0
sources.publisher: PREMIS Editorial Committee / Library of Congress
sources.locator: Introduction pp. 14-19 (structural/derivation relationships, source and event links); Data Dictionary pp. 117-120 (relationshipType, relationshipSubType, relatedObjectIdentifier)
sources.observed_operation: Opened the Library of Congress PDF and inspected relationship explanations and semantic units; no PREMIS XML was authored or validated.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: PREMIS gives a preservation-metadata model; relationship vocabulary and event associations are expressive design elements, not an obligation that this small pilot adopt the entire standard. Unambiguous identifiers and relationship/event context matter.
sources.applicability: Conceptual model for linking original, transcript revisions and access copies, with a simpler local ledger acceptable at pilot scale.

sources.title: Making Audio and Video Media Accessible
sources.publisher: World Wide Web Consortium, Web Accessibility Initiative
sources.version_or_commit: WAI guidance page; latest revision shown as 2024-09-17; not itself a product conformance result
sources.locator: Transcripts and Media Players sections; related planning page lists separate transcript for prerecorded audio-only media and WCAG levels
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official W3C guidance and inspected transcript definition, media-player recommendation and planning resource.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Guidance calls for text of speech and non-speech audio and an accessible player; the exact accessibility features depend on media and user needs. The source does not validate any proposed player or file.
sources.applicability: Supports retaining a human-reviewed transcript and accessibility-minded listening copy as an optional feature and a proposed validation target; no claim of conformance is made.

sources.title: Planning Audio and Video Media
sources.publisher: World Wide Web Consortium, Web Accessibility Initiative
sources.version_or_commit: WAI guidance page in the Making Audio and Video Media Accessible resource; latest resource revision shown as 2024-09-17
sources.locator: Audio-only checklist and WCAG levels: separate transcript for prerecorded audio-only media; user needs and budget/time constraints influence accessibility features; transcripts support deaf-blind users using braille.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official W3C page and inspected its audio-only checklist, WCAG levels, transcript context, and accessible-player references.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The page distinguishes Level A, AA and AAA WCAG items and accessibility features beyond WCAG; transcript selection depends on audio-only vs video and use context.
sources.applicability: Supports the optional transcript and accessibility validation proposal; it is not a result for any local player or transcript.
